# Sample datasets: sources and licences

<!-- Generated by `python3 samples/convert.py notice > samples/NOTICE.md` from catalogue.json. Do not edit. -->

Sources, licences and feed families of the Midgard sample datasets. 'publish' false: kept out of this public repository; available from a local copy of midgard-sample-datasets.zip. Licence classification is conservative and is not legal advice.

The configuration in `1-configuration/` is the work of Veldris Ltd, licensed Apache-2.0.
